notes.title: Banyu Lintar Angin - Little Storm: Patch 1.1 Notes
notes.notes:
Hello hello!

It's been a while since Banyu Lintar Angin was first released, and we've been receiving lots of love from the players. Thank you so much for your support!

And yes, here are some updates on the new patch for Windows version.

Important Changes
[olist]
Steam overlay is now working.
Steam screenshot shortcut is also working now. Capture your most favorite moment with the three siblings!
[/olist]

Minor Changes
[olist]
Bug fix; First button, Last button, and Sound button are now working.
Removed unused files and codes.
[/olist]

Cheers!
